Hearth & Crumb
Today's bakes Our story Visit Pre-order

Baked on Linden Street since 2009

Fresh bread, still warm, every morning.

Slow-fermented sourdough, flaky croissants and seasonal pies — made by hand, before sunrise, a few steps from your front door.

Country Sourdough

Our story

A corner bakery, run by neighbors.

Hearth & Crumb started as a single oven and a hand-painted sign. Fifteen years later we still bake everything on site, still know most of you by name, and still save the end-of-day loaves for the food bank down the street.

    Long ferments for better flavor and easier digestion.

  • Sourced close

    Flour milled two hours away, dairy from Maple Hill Farm.

    Day-olds go to neighbors who need them, every night.

I built a one-page landing page for a made-up bakery called **Hearth & Crumb**. It has the warm, rustic look you picked: cream background, serif headings and crust-brown accents. I checked the top, the bakes section and the bottom of the page in the frame, and they all render cleanly.

From top to bottom:
- **Hero:** headline, two pre-order buttons and a drawn loaf on a plate.
- **Today's bakes:** four cards with illustrations, prices and tags.
- **Our story:** a short history with three values.
- **Hours & location:** opening hours plus a drawn street map.
- **Pre-order:** a dark section with an email sign-up, and a footer.

The name, address, prices, hours and review quote are all placeholders for you to replace. The pre-order form only shows a thank-you note; it doesn't send anything yet.

Look at [Bakery — Landing](onlook://project/blank%2F75a98bb1-d084-477a-9bf9-8b99b776163f/frame/f44cf4c4-52df-45d8-9c47-0870c0f34383) on Page 1.
